sources.snippet: A complete implementation of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to land a rocket on the moon using the LunarLander-v2 environment from OpenAI Gym. This project includes full training, debugging, and enhancement of a faulty PPO pipeline — corrected, improved, and evaluated with advanced techniques like GAE, advantage normalization, and value loss clipping.
